revisionAlgorithm.name: barc-stock-queue-revision-sha256-u64be-v1
revisionAlgorithm.preimageMagic: UTF-8 bytes barc-stock-queue-revision/1 followed by one NUL byte
revisionAlgorithm.fieldEncoding: ordered fields: one-byte tag, four-byte unsigned big-endian byte length, then raw value bytes; repeated row tag 14 preserves row order; the preimage is binary and has no terminator
revisionAlgorithm.stringEncoding: strict UTF-8; lengths count encoded bytes
revisionAlgorithm.scalarEncoding: evidence scheme, tactical revision, actor id and row count are unsigned 32-bit big-endian raw values; catalogue revision and actor lifetime are unsigned 64-bit big-endian raw values
revisionAlgorithm.byteEncoding: catalogue id and game content SHA-256 are raw bytes, not hex text
revisionAlgorithm.rowEncoding: tag 14 contains the canonical ASCII bridge row payload after row= and before newline; domain,id,options.coded,tag,float32params; no timeout
revisionAlgorithm.validation: all fixed values must match; actor id is any uint32 including zero; catalogue revision and actor lifetime are nonzero; catalogue id and content SHA-256 are exact bound bytes; every row domain equals the envelope domain; unavailable/incomplete observations mint no revision
revisionAlgorithm.projection: SHA-256 over the complete binary preimage; first eight digest bytes interpreted as unsigned big-endian uint64
revisionAlgorithm.zeroRule: if the projected uint64 is zero, use one

factoryProductionPolicies.rejectIfBusy: supported only for an observed empty production queue
factoryProductionPolicies.replace: unsupported including empty queue; refuse without append fallback

bridge.length: eight decimal digits equal total bytes including terminal newline
responseFields: ordered row records only when ok
bridge.rowGrammar: row=<domain>|<signed int32 id>|<uint16 options.coded>|<signed int32 tag>|<comma-separated lowercase float32 bit hex>
bridge.float32: exactly eight lowercase IEEE-754 binary32 hex digits; finite only; 80000000 is negative zero and must round-trip or the bridge refuses the value
